benchmark.description: S&P Top 150: buy-and-hold equal weight across 146 names (excl. SPY)

factorAttribution.insight: Earnings momentum had the highest average IC (+0.059, spread +3.0%/period). DCF averaged negative IC (-0.040) — adaptive weights should not increase that pillar when IC stays negative. Suggested blend vs effective ranking mix: Earnings momentum 18% → 18%.

congressMeta.note: Scores reflect recent public disclosures as of this response, not the simulated calendar date. The ranking nudge in-backtest applies only when the simulated rebalance is near “today” (see server).
